summary.intent: Run a wave of parallel subagents that each handle a separate monokl repo task tracked as an Entire trail: bump Callisto to 0.17.0, clean up repo hygiene, add pinning tests, and fix a stack overflow.
summary.outcome: Two of four PRs are up and reported: #41 (Callisto 0.17.0 bump, trail 190) and #40 (repo hygiene, trail 191). The pinning-tests (183) and stack-overflow-fix (184) agents were still running.

repo: `entire trail link` auto-opens a draft 'shadow' PR for the branch, so `gh pr create` reports a PR already exists. The workaround is to edit that PR (title, body, mark ready) rather than create a second one.
Keep the hidden `<!-- entire-shadow-pr -->` marker at the end of the PR body, because Entire uses it to close the PR when the trail closes.
The release workflow filename `callisto-release.yml` must stay unchanged because attestation checks depend on it.

The Callisto pin is a plugin commit (`ff116694`) with `# callisto@0.17.0` comments in workflows, plus `.prototools`. The `setup-callisto` steps now use `verification: require`, which fails the job if the binary cannot be verified.
The justfile `changesets` recipe now runs `callisto status --check --strict`.

`callisto release pending` shows monokl@0.2.0 was published to crates.io but has no GitHub release, because it was released before GitHub releases were configured. This is harmless, since 0.3.0 will create its own.
`.github/dependabot.yml` on main already has `cooldown: default-days: 7` for both cargo and github-actions.
Work tracking moved from `.claude/plans` and `ACTIVE.md` to Entire trails in project gh/orin-dx (monokl trails 182-191). `.claude/specs/` and the decision log intentionally keep old references.
CODEOWNERS (owner @castrog) was copied verbatim from callisto, and the PR template ends with a `Trail:` link line.
workflow: Subagent worktrees run in parallel on separate branches, and each commit ends with a `Claude-Session` line and is GPG-signed.
Network operations (git fetch/push, gh, entire, proto install) needed the sandbox disabled because of TLS and network restrictions.
The installed callisto shim was on 0.14.0, so verifying a bump required `proto install callisto 0.17.0` first.
Verification used `just zizmor` and `just typos`, and no cargo builds were run since no Rust changed.

friction: Entire's auto-created draft shadow PR conflicted with `gh pr create`, so both agents had to edit the existing PR instead.
The sandbox blocked `gh` TLS and network access, so many commands needed the sandbox disabled.
The Callisto shim was stale at 0.14.0, so it had to be installed separately before verification.
The hygiene agent did not fetch caliper's dependabot file for comparison because of the TLS block, and judged the existing config complete.
open_items: Pinning tests PR (trail 183) and stack-overflow fix PR (trail 184) are still in progress.
Branch protection must require code-owner review for CODEOWNERS to be enforced, which is a GitHub setting that has not been changed.
Check that each of the remaining PRs ends up as a single non-draft PR after the Entire shadow PR behavior.
The monokl@0.2.0 GitHub release gap is visible in `callisto release pending` but was left as is.
Old references to the removed plan and blocker files remain in SPEC-009.json, SPEC-010.json and docs/spec/05-research-and-decisions.md, left alone on purpose.
